convert_transformer_checkpoint: convert a JoyImageEdit transformer checkpoint to diffusers format and save to output path
convert_vae_checkpoint: convert a JoyImageEdit VAE checkpoint to diffusers format and save to output path
build_diffusers_pipeline: build a complete JoyImageEdit diffusers pipeline with transformer, vae, text encoder, and scheduler
get_transformer_config: get the transformer configuration dictionary with hidden size, attention heads, and patch size parameters
run_conversion_cli: run the conversion script via argparse CLI with transformer and vae checkpoint paths and output directory
